claim: FT2: fabric screens give visual privacy in assessment and treatment
law: ANSUR II standing eye height 1,753 mm (men 95th), about 1,780 mm in shoes
check: First drawn with the fabric top at 1,730 mm, a tall man saw over it (independent review 2026-11-12: refuted). Screens now 1.9 m with the fabric top at 1,830 mm

claim: FT2: the screen bay packs within the deck's 12 kg
law: Aluminium posts, rails and 6 mm aluminium base plates from the model (42.9 kg); fabric 0.20 to 0.45 kg/m2 ASSUMED (A8) on 43.9 m2
check: 53.2 to 64.1 kg: heavier than FT1 because it is 1.8 m tall and its frame is metal
closed_by: Same decision as S1 (FXT-DEC-001 D2); option not carried

claim: FT2: 2.1 m door headers give headroom and carry split magnetic curtains that need no hand
check: Clearance about 217 mm under the rail; the curtain closes by gravity and magnets but touches the face and shoulders of everyone who passes, so it is body contact, not hands-free in the IPC sense

claim: FT2: the fabric meets NFPA 701 and can be disinfected
law: IFR knit drape listing 'will pass NFPA 701' (Urquid Linen); PVC-coated polyester is wipeable but its FR report is to source
check: Knit drape is laundered, not wiped; the wipeable coated fabric adds mass (X2) and needs its own fire report

claim: FT2: a screen bay costs about the deck's USD 800
law: Pipe-and-drape kit USD 179.99 per two 8 ft uprights, two bases and a crossbar (Urquid Linen); FR drape about USD 50 a panel
check: About USD 2060 for 14 posts and 16 panels at commercial prices; a DIY frame would cost less (to assess)

claim: FT2: the post frame resists the 178 N push
law: Posts on 300 mm aluminium base plates, push at 1,372 mm; the bag sits beside the plate, not on it
check: One post tips at about 3 N, 8 N with the bag on the plate (independent review 2026-11-12); like FT1 it stands only where its frame is braced
closed_by: Option not carried; same decision as D7

claim: FT3: a belt stanchion resists the 178 N push
law: Uline H-3736BL: 42 lb post on a 14 in base; tipping about the base rim, push at the belt height
check: 34.2 N per post (fails); belts carry no moment. A stanchion line marks a boundary, it does not stand a bump; that is a scope change
closed_by: Option not carried; stated limit if Amish chooses FT3

claim: FT3: the stanchion bay is portable
law: Uline H-3736BL 42 lb per post; water-fillable posts (Montour) empty mass not stated
check: 14 steel posts weigh about 267 kg; water-fillable posts would be light empty but their mass is to assess

claim: FT3: belts at 0.97 m separate cohorts
law: Belt height 40 in post (Uline, Global Industrial)
check: A belt guides walking patients and marks the boundary; people can duck under, stretchers cannot be screened, no privacy

law: 14 posts and 12 belts at 30 to 60 s each; 22 m of floor tape at 2 to 4 m a minute (A9); two people at 70 to 85 % useful time as FT1
check: About 11 to 26 min; tape is the slow part, and moving 267 kg of steel posts is not counted

claim: FT3: floor tape and post signs stay legible
law: Vinyl floor tape 5 to 6 mil (Global Industrial listing)
check: Trafficked floor tape soils and lifts under wet mopping; signs on posts read like FT1's

law: Steel posts, cast bases, nylon belts and vinyl tape
check: Only the belts and tape burn, well under FT1's panels

claim: FT3: a stanchion bay costs about USD 850 to 1,200 against the USD 800 target
law: Uline USD 54.50 a post (5 or more cartons); Montour water-fill USD 79.79; tape USD 10.25 a roll
check: USD 844 with steel posts, USD 1198 with water-fill posts; over the target either way

claim: FT1 at P18 (1.8 m walls, privacy variant)
law: Same zigzag plan with P18 duos (FXP-PLT-001 module, clips at 150, 1,050 and 1,650 mm); flat-strip factor 0.51 (FXP-PLT-001 P2); held leaf (FXP-PLT-001 P3)
check: 53.7 kg and 21 sheets (USD 945 of sheet). With v0.2 zigzag walls a held 600 mm leaf at 1,800 mm is 6.29 cold and 3.14 hot (FXP-PLT-001 P3 gives 3.1 and 1.6 after its load factor of 2), so P18 now stands structurally; it fails the pack target, like S1, and needs a lateral criterion, like S6
